Message:
I couldn’t answer
that girl’s question...
Even though that’s
the only way to avenge
the Hero of the Staff’s death...

Despite knowing that though,
when I first came
to the Duke’s mansion,
there was part of me
that felt relieved to learn
Elaine wasn’t here...

Her betrayal is unforgivable.
Taking the Hero of the Staff’s life
even more so.
Elaine was a part of our journey,

And...she also loved
the Hero of the Staff...

So much so that...my affections
didn’t hold a candle to hers.

I just can’t believe someone
like her could do such a thing...
Part of me...
just can’t let that thought go...

I’ll never come to an answer,
no matter how long I think.
So first, I’ll hear
what you have to say.

I can think about what
to do next after that.

But before I see you again,
there are a few things
I need to accomplish first...!
